responsibility: Provides collect2’s cross-host AIX support layer by implementing a minimal ldfcn-style API over mapped XCOFF objects and big archives when native AIX headers and libraries are unavailable. It is responsible for opening AIX object files or archive members, parsing big-endian XCOFF file and symbol-table records, retrieving symbol names from inline or string-table storage, and iterating archive members through ldopen, ldtbread, ldgetname, and ldclose so collect2 can scan constructor, destructor, and export symbols in cross-compilation builds.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of collect2's AIX cross-support pair: it contains the mmap-based code that opens archives/objects, parses big-endian XCOFF records, and implements ldopen/ldtbread/ldgetname/ldclose. Unlike gcc/collect2-aix.h, it performs the actual file parsing rather than defining the compatibility structs, constants, and API types.
